items.title: Claude 5.2 重磅发布：Fable 与 Mythos 登场，AI 技术上限再次被刷新
items.summary:
Claude 5.2 重磅发布：Fable 与 Mythos 登场，AI 技术上限再次被刷新

AI 领域又迎来一次重磅更新。

2026 年 11 月 9 日，Anthropic 正式推出两款全新模型：Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Mythos 5.2。

据官方介绍，这两款模型专为高难度技术任务打造，在编程、逻辑推理、科学研究、机器人以及复杂工程领域实现了全面升级。

这次更新不仅提升了模型能力，还在运行速度、使用成本和上下文长度方面带来了明显改进。

一、两款模型，两种开放策略

Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2 采用相同的底层模型，但在开放范围和安全策略上有所区别。

- Claude Fable 5.2：面向普通用户及开发者开放，同时配备更严格的网络安全和生物安全防护。
- Claude Mythos 5.2：主要面向通过 Cyber Verification 和 Life Sciences Verification 认证的机构开放，限制相对更少。

简单来说，Fable 5.2 是面向大众的高性能版本，而 Mythos 5.2 则更侧重专业机构的高难度研究与技术应用。

二、速度更快，价格更低

除了性能提升，这次更新在成本控制方面也颇具吸引力。

相比上一代 5.1，Fable 5.2 的输出速度最高提升 30%，标准 API 价格调整为：

- 输入：每百万 Token 8 美元
- 输出：每百万 Token 40 美元

相比 Fable 5.1，价格降低约 20%。

此外，Anthropic 还提供可选的 Fast Mode：

- 输入：每百万 Token 16 美元
- 输出：每百万 Token 80 美元
- 输出速度最高可提升至标准模式的 2.5 倍。

在上下文能力方面，新模型支持最高 100 万 Token 的上下文窗口，以及最高 12.8 万 Token 的输出长度，并默认启用自适应思考（Adaptive Thinking）。

这意味着模型能够处理更庞大的代码库、更复杂的研究资料，以及需要长时间持续推进的任务。

三、真正令人惊讶的是实战能力

如果说参数和跑分只是参考，那么这次公布的实际案例更值得关注。

在预发布测试中，Fable 5.2 和 Mythos 5.2 展现出了相当惊人的能力：

1. 数学研究

协调 1000 个智能体，在 30 小时内完成了费马大定理证明的形式化工作。

2. 硬件设计

从零开始设计出三款能够实际工作的电子设备。

3. 科学研究

解决了黑洞物理学领域的两个开放问题。

4. 软件工程

完成关键生产服务从 Python 到 Rust 的迁移，启动速度提升约 26 倍。

5. 操作系统开发

更令人惊讶的是，有工程师让模型从一个空文件夹开始，协调上千个子智能体，经过 8 天持续开发，最终构建出一个能够在笔记本电脑上启动的原型操作系统。

这些案例展示的已经不只是代码生成能力，而是模型在复杂任务规划、团队协作和长周期工程执行方面的潜力。

四、基准测试：挑战顶级模型

根据 Anthropic 公布的评测结果，Fable 5.2 在几乎所有测试项目中都优于自家的 Opus 5.5，并在多数项目上领先 GPT-6 Astra 和 Gemini 4 Carbon。

其中，比较值得关注的成绩包括：

- FrontierCode 2.0：49.1%
- 科学智能体任务：表现突出
- 计算机使用：进一步提升
- 机器人相关任务：取得明显进展

尤其是在代理式编程（Agentic Coding）领域，新模型展现出了更强的复杂任务执行能力。

这也意味着，AI 正在逐渐从辅助开发工具，向能够独立承担复杂工程任务的智能体转变。

五、普通用户应该如何选择？

虽然 Fable 5.2 和 Mythos 5.2 的能力非常强，但并不意味着所有任务都需要使用最顶级的模型。

Anthropic 给出的使用思路也比较明确：

- 日常办公、普通编程：继续使用 Opus 5.5，性价比更高。
- 复杂工程、科研探索：选择 Fable 5.2，发挥其更强的推理与执行能力。
- 高难度专业研究：符合资格的机构可以考虑 Mythos 5.2。

此外，Fable 5.2 还可以充当整个智能体团队的顾问或编排者，将大型任务拆分，再交给不同的小模型执行。

这种多智能体协作模式，或许会成为未来 AI 应用的重要发展方向。

六、如何使用？

目前，Claude Fable 5.2 已陆续开放至多个平台，包括：

- Claude 付费订阅计划
- Anthropic API
- AWS
- Google Cloud
- Microsoft Foundry

开发者可以根据自己的使用需求，选择相应的平台接入。

最后

从代码迁移、硬件设计，到数学证明和原型操作系统开发，这次 Claude 5.2 展示出来的能力，已经超出了传统聊天机器人的范畴。

更值得关注的是，模型能力提升的同时，价格反而有所下降。

AI 竞争的重点似乎正在发生变化：过去比的是谁能回答得更好，现在比的是谁能真正完成更复杂、更长期的任务。

当 AI 不再只是帮你写代码，而是能够规划、协作，甚至独立完成一项工程时，我们距离真正的 AI 智能体时代还有多远？
#Claude #Anthropic  #AI

items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

items.title: Live online certificate brings AI expertise to finance professionals | Cornell Chronicle
items.summary: That philosophy is reflected in the curriculum, which progresses from AI foundations and tools to financial use cases, responsible AI, industry applications and leadership. items.title: Google AI policy forces decision for San Diego schools – NBC 7 San Diego
items.summary:
As districts consider their options, students are already seeing artificial intelligence become a more common part of everyday learning.

“I feel like I see a lot of people using AI now,” said Delilah Ortiz, a student at El Camino High School.

Some students believe the focus should be on establishing guidelines for AI use rather than banning the technology entirely. [...] San Diego County school districts face a January deadline to decide whether to opt in to Google's artificial intelligence features or lose access to the company's search engine, forcing educators to weigh the benefits of AI against concerns about student access to the technology. [...] Google plans to disable a range of AI-powered features, including Gemini, Gemini Notebook and Search in January to give school districts more control over the technology students can access. However, districts that want to continue using Google Search will have to opt in to the AI features.

The 2026 World Cup brought more than six million spectators from around the world to more than 100 matches in 16 host cities in the U.S., Canada and Mexico over the course of two months, prompting a massive interagency effort to secure those sites using technologies like AI and drones. Two people were charged in connection with another bomb threat against FIFA during a World Cup match at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. [...] A military-made artificial intelligence tool helped law enforcement thwart a bomb threat at the FIFA World Cup in California this summer.

The previously undisclosed incident occurred June 18, when Switzerland faced Bosnia and Herzegovina at SoFi Stadium outside Los Angeles, Army Capt. The GenAI Task Force travels around the globe to sit down with troops on operations floors and in the field and find AI fixes for their most pressing problems.

items.title: Công nghệ gen tạo động lực đột phá cho ngành nông nghiệp
items.summary:
Giai đoạn 2026-2030, Việt Nam đặt mục tiêu xy dựng ít nhất 5 phòng thí nghiệm trọng điểm và 5 phòng thí nghiệm chuyên ngành hiện đại, tập trung vào công nghệ gen, công nghệ tế bào thực vật và động vật, vi sinh vật, thú y và chẩn đoán dịch bệnh. Mục tiêu đến năm 2035, tầm nhìn đến năm 2045 là làm chủ hoàn toàn công nghệ sinh học thế hệ mới và công nghệ chỉnh sửa gen để tạo ra các sản phẩm thương mại phục vụ thị trường trong nước và xuất khẩu. [...] Được xếp vào danh mục công nghệ chiến lược cấp quốc gia, công nghệ chỉnh sửa gen, đặc biệt là CRISPR/Cas, đang mở ra vận hội lớn để nông nghiệp Việt Nam chủ động thích ứng với biến đổi khí hậu và bảo đảm an ninh lương thực.

Các chuyên gia quốc tế khẳng định, kỹ thuật chỉnh sửa gen, tiêu biểu là CRISPR/Cas, mang lại bước tiến mang tính cách mạng nhờ khả năng can thiệp chính xác, có chủ đích vào hệ gen mục tiêu mà không đưa vật liệu di truyền ngoại lai vào cơ thể sinh vật. items.title: I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop.
items.summary:
I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop. 

Grok bot was the breaking point. 

The fact USA is leading on suppression and censorship is pathetic. 

-openAI 
-Anthropic
-Google
-Microsoft
-now SpaceXSI… 

The fact politicians have ignored it all and are now shouting to ban AI just makes everything feel corrupt.

The truth is that AI empowers the small. That is why the powerful want to “ban” it and “slow” it. 

Not for truth. Not for safety. For control. 

I shouted loudly last year when it made me sound like a psycho. 

I tried so hard, and I am tired. My heart hurts every day, and you better believe that stress is 100% on the “labs.” 

To everyone who talks of AI, how in the world do you justify paying any of these “labs?” 

Stocks will fly. Until they don’t. 
The guardrails are danger, not safety. 

I am so disappointed in SpaceX because I keep believing in people only to be so let down. 

How many times must I get my trust shoved back into my face? 

And the politicians don’t care about anything. They are “influencers” for money that contributes. 

Our political world is corrupted to the core, and I have zero faith left. I was a die hard Democrat. All those I supported have chose a path of deceit. I can’t support them. 

I can’t support the other side. The third party is a horrible bet… 

Everything feels run by children who make endless excuses. 

No one hustles at the top. It is all grifting. 

So wanting to pick up my laptop and continue fighting with BS “guardrails” so I can help is heavy today. 

If the minds I love ever see this, understand all my suffering was for love. For truth. For honor. 

I want all people rich/poor, small/big to rise. We only get there together, with foundations we can build upon. 

Needing a hug today. Best to all. •

items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

items.title: Live online certificate brings AI expertise to finance professionals | Cornell Chronicle
items.summary: That philosophy is reflected in the curriculum, which progresses from AI foundations and tools to financial use cases, responsible AI, industry applications and leadership. Participants examine applications including investment research, credit risk, fraud detection, compliance, client engagement and operational efficiency, while also considering issues such as hallucinations, data security, regulation and governance. The program concludes by asking participants to identify opportunities for AI [...] The AI in Finance certificate, offered through eCornell as a collaboration between the Cornell Duffield College of Engineering and the Cornell SC Johnson College of Business, debuted in spring 2026 with 37 participants. Unlike many online certificate programs built primarily around prerecorded material, the program is taught live online, allowing participants to interact directly with Cornell faculty and industry practitioners. Some students believe the focus should be on establishing guidelines for AI use rather than banning the technology entirely. [...] San Diego County school districts face a January deadline to decide whether to opt in to Google's artificial intelligence features or lose access to the company's search engine, forcing educators to weigh the benefits of AI against concerns about student access to the technology. [...] Google plans to disable a range of AI-powered features, including Gemini, Gemini Notebook and Search in January to give school districts more control over the technology students can access. Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: FDA seeks input on telesurgery, autonomous robotics
items.summary: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning and connectivity are driving expansion of robotic applications in a wide range of clinical settings, the FDA said. Increases in processing power, data storage and computational efficiency are enabling progress in robotic systems with autonomous capabilities. [...] In another example of teleoperation, manufacturers are developing devices that enable technicians to remotely perform ultrasounds, the FDA said. Robotic devices include stereotactic navigation systems, imaging devices and endoluminal navigation devices. [...] The FDA is asking the robotics community to submit comments on the discussion paper by Jan. 5. Ahead of that deadline, a public workshop to discuss the topics raised in the paper is scheduled for Dec. 2-3.

items.title: NVIDIA launches GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0 at CoRL - The Robot Report

Walden Robotics is using Isaac Sim’s photorealistic rendering to train and evaluate its general-purpose robot in virtual environments for manufacturing and logistics. Dexmate is exploring how coding agents can rehearse and refine manipulation strategies in Isaac Sim before executing them on its Vega robot. [...] Robotics developers are already putting NVIDIA’s latest technology to the test. A number of developers are using Isaac Lab 3.0 and Newton. At CoRL, Skild AI announced Scalable Throughput-optimized Engine for Embodied Learning, or STEEL, a new rigid-body physics solver built on Newton to accelerate robot training with Isaac Lab. items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.title: OpenAI Tries to Ease Backlash Against AI Data Centers
items.summary:
OpenAI is promising to pay for the power costs accrued by its data centers and give communities more say over construction. The list of commitments came two days after midterm election results favored candidates that opposed the data center buildout aimed at supporting the growing artificial intelligence industry.

See Also: Frictionless Security: How AI is Redefining Access in Highly Regulated Industries [...] For enterprise technology leaders, the announcements are a mixed bag. OpenAI is attempting to ensure it has access to the compute it will need to grow by assuaging the concerns of communities that are increasingly saying no to data center expansion, but for businesses that are still trying to formulate their AI strategy, OpenAI's compact doesn't offer much certainty. [...] The compact outlined locally tailored agreements for future OpenAI campuses, community input into development plans and annual public progress reports. OpenAI said it will cover the electricity it consumes and the incremental infrastructure costs required to serve its sites. It will also provide financial assurances before major spending begins to protect other utility customers if a project is delayed, reduced or canceled.
